Moon.1: The Moon in its own place gives food, perfume, garlands, women, friends, garments, and sexual intercourse
Moon.2: in the second it causes many expenses, difficulties, and despair
Moon.3: in the third the Moon gives clothes, gold, women, friends, glory, and food
Moon.4: in the fourth it causes griefs which arise from the sufferings of one's relatives and the loss of one's wealth
Moon.5: in the fifth the Moon causes the loss of one's wealth, indigestion, diseases, wandering, poverty, and agitation
Moon.6: in the sixth the destruction of one's foes, good health, sons, money, success, affection, learning, and joy
Moon.7: in the seventh the Moon gives women, wealth, relatives, beds, gold, food, and clothes
Moon.8: in the eighth hunger, diseases, anxiety, quarrels, loss of one's money, death, decay, and distress
Moon.9: in the ninth the Moon oversees the loss of one's wealth, illness, expenses, the ruin of one's honor, and hindrances
Moon.10: in the tenth it produces much honor, joy, profits from one's activities, nobility, and distinction
Moon.11: in the eleventh affection, the marriage-bed, women, food, joy, happiness, and money
Moon.12: in the twelfth the Moon causes poverty, laziness, and the diminution of one's honor

Sun.1: The Moon in the place of the Sun produces misery in one's body
Sun.2: in the second it gives wandering and disease
Sun.3: in the third it causes joy, victory, and good health
Sun.4: in the fourth it gives the breaking of one's weapons and spells (mantra), and fevers
Sun.5: in the fifth it causes an increase in strife and evil
Sun.6: in the sixth joy and victory
Sun.7: in the seventh the Moon gives consideration for one's mother's family (kula)
Sun.8: in the eighth success with regard to money
Sun.9: in the ninth it causes the aversion of one's elders (gurus)
Sun.10: in the tenth it gives power, glory, and wealth
Sun.11: in the eleventh the Moon gives distinguished garments, gold, and metals (loha)

Saturn.1: The Moon in the place of Saturn causes hunger and blows with boulders
Saturn.2: in the second the diminution of one's money
Saturn.3: in the third the acquisition of glory and wealth
Saturn.4: in the fourth wind(-diseases), fevers, and poverty
Saturn.5: in the fifth the Moon produces wealth and flowers
Saturn.6: in the sixth the destruction of one's enemies and an accumulation of strength
Saturn.7: in the seventh pain in mind and body
Saturn.8: in the eighth the loss of one's money
Saturn.9: in the ninth it (causes) wind(-diseases), belly(-aches), indigestion, and failure in one's actions
Saturn.10: in the tenth it gives possessions
Saturn.11: in the eleventh the Moon causes illness among one's slaves and quadrupeds
Saturn.12: in the twelfth quarrels with bad people

Jupiter.1: The Moon in the place of Jupiter produces knowledge, wealth, and fame
Jupiter.2: in the second honor and wealth
Jupiter.3: in the third it causes separation from one's wife and friends
Jupiter.4: in the fourth it gives women, enjoyment, prosperity, and wealth
Jupiter.5: in the fifth the Moon gives status, brilliance, and fear among one's foes
Jupiter.6: in the sixth it delivers diseases
Jupiter.7: in the seventh it gives a wife, clothes, and strength
Jupiter.8: in the eighth wealth and power
Jupiter.9: in the ninth it causes bondage, mischief, and ill-fame to oneself
Jupiter.10: in the tenth it conquers one's foes
Jupiter.11: in the eleventh it causes the acquisition of food and vehicles
Jupiter.12: and in the twelfth an increase of sickness in the head

Venus.1: The Moon in the place of Venus causes agitation in one's wife's family (kula)
Venus.3: in the third it gives victory, clothes, and cows
Venus.4: in the fourth merchandise, wealth, and food
Venus.5: in the fifth the Moon produces honor, learning, and fame
Venus.6: in the sixth disease and obstruction
Venus.7: in the seventh an increase in one's poverty
Venus.8: in the eighth it gives sickness and fear
Venus.9: in the ninth the Moon causes honor and victory
Venus.10: in the tenth the attainment of wealth
Venus.11: in the eleventh it gives the acquisition of profit, pleasure, clothes, and women
Venus.12: and in the twelfth it produces joy

Mars.1: The Moon in the place of Mars gives wandering, disease, separation, and enemies
Mars.2: in the second it produces power
Mars.3: in the third lordship and pleasure
Mars.4: in the fourth envy, illness, and anxiety
Mars.5: in the fifth authority, reverence, profit, and nobility
Mars.6: in the sixth the murder of one's enemies
Mars.7: in the seventh blood(-diseases), wounds, and faults
Mars.8: in the eighth the Moon gives wandering, imprisonment, and disease
Mars.9: in the ninth the Moon gives brilliance and prosperity
Mars.10: in the tenth authority and beauty
Mars.11: in the eleventh the Moon causes the acquisition of fame and great wealth
Mars.12: and in the twelfth the ruin of one's property

Mercury.1: The Moon in the place of Mercury produces such things as children, knowledge, and pleasure
Mercury.2: in the second it gives desirable things
Mercury.3: in the third it produces beauty, good qualities, and fame
Mercury.4: in the fourth confused speech and distress
Mercury.5: in the fifth the Moon produces censure and the resorting to evil
Mercury.6: in the sixth contempt from an ignoble person (anarya)
Mercury.7: in the seventh intellect, joy, and treasure
Mercury.8: in the eighth it gives money and status
Mercury.9: in the ninth it causes the purity of one's character
Mercury.10: in the tenth success with regard to one's words, thoughts, and actions
Mercury.11: in the eleventh the Moon gives wealth from one's friends and sons
Mercury.12: in the twelfth an increase in one's poverty

Ascendant.1: The Moon in the ascendent gives vomiting, fevers, indigestion, strife, fatigue, wandering, enemies, and death
Ascendant.2: in the second it causes the loss of one's wealth, diseases of the eyes, travels, thefts, expenses, aversion, and anger
Ascendant.3: in the third the Moon gives honor, women, authority, wealth, garments, lands, and joy
Ascendant.4: in the fourth the Moon produces quarrels with one's relatives, diseases, poverty, anger, and calumny
Ascendant.5: in the fifth the illness of one's sons, the loss of one's money, the poisoning of one's friends' affection, and expenses
Ascendant.6: in the sixth the Moon causes the destruction of one's enemies, honor, good health, and the accumulation of money
Ascendant.7: in the seventh the Moon produces weariness from wandering, anxiety about one's money, jealousy, sorrow, and homelessness
Ascendant.8: in the eighth one's own death, hunger, wandering, imprisonment, fever, sword(-wounds), and delusions
Ascendant.9: in the ninth the Moon causes one's dependence on others, wandering, aversion, greed, delusion, impotence, and dishonor
Ascendant.10: in the tenth success in business, happiness, the acquisition of wealth, and respect
Ascendant.11: in the eleventh the Moon causes the acquisition of women, silver, food, drink, good clothes, position, and quadrupeds
Ascendant.12: in the twelfth from the ascendent trouble in one's business and the loss of one's profits
